title: Hours
queryHint: Tell your carer what looks off — this holds off approval until it's sorted.
queryNotePlaceholder: e.g. Thursday looks longer than expected
flaggedDescription: This entry has zero duration — usually from an accidental clock-in and clock-out. This week has already been approved, so ask your household to query it if it needs correcting.
emptyWeek: No hours logged this week yet.
waitingForHours: Approve unlocks once your carer has logged hours this week.
waitingAfterQuery: Waiting for your carer to adjust hours after your query.
payBoundary: Steadily totals the pay; the payment itself happens outside the app.
earningsReopenedNote: Hours changed after approval, so this week is being worked out again.
earningsCouldntCompute: Couldn't work out the total just now.
earningsNoArrangementParent: No pay rate set — Steadily can't total this week.
earningsNoArrangementNanny: Your family hasn't set a pay rate in Steadily yet, so there's no total here. Your hours are still recorded.
earningsCurrencyChange: This week spans a currency change — ask your family to check the terms.
earningsDepartedCarer: {{name}} is no longer in this household, so this week can't be totalled.
earningsLineCancellationSubline: {{duration}} at {{rate}} · paid under your cancellation policy
earningsLineTopupZeroHoursSubline: Your family was away this week.
earningsReimbursementsNote: Expenses are listed separately and are not part of gross pay.
earningsFooterNote: Based on the hours recorded in Steadily. Tax and deductions are handled by your payroll.
approveDialogBody: You're approving {{hours}} and {{gross}} gross for {{name}}. Approving locks both figures — if hours change later, the week reopens and the total is worked out again.
approveDialogBodyNoArrangement: You're approving {{hours}} for {{name}}. No pay rate is set, so Steadily can't total the pay for this week.
